caption:
Costa Rica's mountain routes do not negotiate with gears. Out here, mountain biking in Costa Rica eventually brings you to a grade where pushing the bike is simply the smartest line forward. The mud grips your tires, the cloud forest closes in above the ridgeline, and the only sound left is your breath keeping rhythm with the climb. In terrain like this, patience is as much a gear as any cog on your cassette.
